native.query:
SELECT 
    SUBSTR(l.name, 1, 6) AS version, c.status AS consent_status, COUNT(*) AS `count`
FROM consent c
JOIN (
    SELECT 
        broadcast.name, contact_id, MAX(created_at) latest 
    FROM broadcast
    JOIN broadcast_link link ON link.broadcast_id=broadcast.id
    JOIN source s ON s.id = link.source_id
    JOIN consent ON consent.source_id=s.id
    WHERE {{broadcast_test_id}}
    GROUP BY broadcast.id, contact_id
) l ON l.contact_id=c.contact_id AND l.latest=c.created_at
GROUP BY version, consent_status

native.query:
SELECT 
    c.status, COUNT(*) AS `count`
FROM consent c
JOIN (
    SELECT 
        contact_id, MAX(created_at) latest 
    FROM broadcast_link
    JOIN source s ON s.id = broadcast_link.source_id
    JOIN consent ON consent.source_id=s.id
    WHERE {{broadcast_id}}
    GROUP BY contact_id
) l ON l.contact_id=c.contact_id AND l.latest=c.created_at
GROUP BY status

826.description:
An open is the act of displaying the content of a broadcast.
For mailings, it is typically captured by adding to the broadcast content an image stored in a system that counts requests to that image, which may not capture all actual opens (if the recipient does not display images).

815.description:
A donation a type of action: it is the intent from a person to give money to the organisation, either once or periodically. The intent may or may not be eventually fulfilled.
N.B.: The campaign associated to a donation (through action and action page) is not the campaign for which the money should be used, but rather the campaign that led the person to donate.
815.name: donation

A share is associated to 2 source records: the one that led to the share action (the action source), and the one that will be the source of any action coming from that share (the shared source).

827.description:
An unsub is the request from a broadcast recipient not to receive further broadcasts anymore. 
While people may send such a request through different means, an unsub refers specifically to the act of using one of the unsuscribe options that are mandatory in any mass communication.

870.description:
In this database, a consent is either any event regarding a person's explicit consent to have their personal data processed or used for a certain purpose.
It may be an asynchronous consent ask, an asynchronous consent response, a synchronous consent ask and response, or an unsollicited consent cancellation.
870.name: consent

6977.description:

 - accepted: the person became a member
 - rejected: the person refused to become a member
 - pending: the person was asked asynchronously (eg by email) to become a member
 - cancelled: the person withdrew their consent

811.description:
In the context of analytics, a campaign is a "project" with a political and/or organisational goal. It is the primary concept used to focus data analysis to a specific area or goal. 
N.B.: It may be different from what your action tool or CRM may refer to as campaign, which is rather a technical definition and is closer to the analytics concept of action page.
811.name: campaign

6497.description:

 - wemove: a "regular" campaign run by the organisation
 - youmove: a campaign initiated by a citizen or organisation on the Youmove platform
 - eci: European Citizen Initiative
 - trial: a campaign run the organisation to assess its potential success
6497.name: campaign_type

812.description:
A segmentation is a way split a group of people into different segments (sub-groups).
This split is a partition: each person of the base group is attributed to exactly one segment (everyone is in a segment, no-one is in more than one segment).
812.name: segmentation

890.name: campaign_metric

7082.description:
One of the following:
 - recipients: number of broadcast recipients targeted by the campaign
 - messages: total number of broadcast messages (emails, sms, etc) sent for the campaign
 - unsubs: number of people who unsubscribed through a broadcast of the campaign
 - actions: total number of actions of any type attributed to the campaign
 - new_members: total number of people who subscribed to the organisation mailing list thanks to the campaign
 - activated: number of people who joined the active members'segment via an action linked to the campaign
 - shares: number of actions of type share associated to the campaign
 - donations_total_amount: total amount of money (one-off and recurring total) fundraised via the campaign
7082.name: metric
